scope: Separate opt-in experimental CLI/store. Original user store, CLI and production profile preserved.
primary: Live native full GGSQ images at exact absolute processed positions; observe split-no-save controls and fresh physical context before comparative timings.
numerics: First test split/no-save repeat reproducibility. Compare raw full vocabulary rows to independently generated non-restored identical splits. Report all differences, top1, TV, max abs. Do not treat equal restored-to-restored as a positive control.
comparison: Order off/fixed/auto, fixed/auto/off, auto/off/fixed. Identical rendered synthetic input, edited prefix lengths and horizon across arms. Distinguish segmentation from native capture; separate calibrated observations from evaluation.
budget: Formal hard cap only for optional checkpoint image bytes on disk including in-flight staging. Also honor existing store-wide legacy retained-image budget. SQLite/WAL, heap and OS caches outside image byte ceiling. No production adoption.
